title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Zenodo record by Heaviside Analytics. Chronos-2, Timestral-209M and TimesFM 2.5, zero-shot, on GB national demand a day ahead; models and a weekly-lag regression get the same ECMWF forecasts as public at the 09:30 issue time. Preregistered backtest, 960 days, 16 Mar 2024 to 31 Oct 2026. Date is from the feed record; the fetched page shows none.

title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Results: weather cut mean daily error by 34% (regression), 32% (Chronos-2), 23% (Timestral), 6% (TimesFM 2.5), each confirmed at a 5% study-wide error rate. Chronos-2 closed 62% of its gap to NESO's forecast. The models' edge over the regression largely disappears with weather. Backtest may overlap training data; a live window to 31 Mar 2027 comes in part 2.

title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
note: Process: plan, code and inputs frozen and hashed at tag weather-plan (10 Nov 2026) before any model saw real weather; scored once; gate checks passed. Archive is a snapshot of AndyMoran/gb-foundation-model-tests: LICENSE, plans, locks, RESULTS.md, results.json, forecasts, power analyses, DEVIATIONS.md. Weather code is in AndyMoran/gb-weather-private.

title: AndyMoran/gb-foundation-model-tests (README)
note: Repository of the study series, MIT licence. First study (no weather, 1,035 days): Chronos-2 at 0.928 of the weekly-lag regression's error, Timestral 0.910, TimesFM 2.5 1.009. Holds plans, locks, code, results for both studies; weather study under weather_study/ at tag weather-plan. Weights are fetched at pinned revisions: Chronos-2 and TimesFM 2.5 Apache 2.0, Timestral Modified MIT.

title: Weather study results note, part 1 of 2 (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: Q1, confirmatory, 960 days: error with weather over error without, 90% intervals: regression 0.658 (0.631-0.686), Chronos-2 0.683 (0.658-0.707), Timestral 0.773 (0.751-0.796), TimesFM 2.5 0.941 (0.913-0.968); each one-sided p below 0.0005 against a level of 0.0125. Moving-block bootstrap over days. Scored once on 11 Nov 2026; all 20 gate checks passed.

title: Weather study results note, part 1 of 2 (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: Q3, descriptive: with the same weather, model error over the regression's: Chronos-2 0.966 (0.931-1.001), Timestral 1.074 (1.034-1.115), TimesFM 2.5 1.453 (1.394-1.510); without weather these were 0.932, 0.914, 1.017. Q2: weather closed 456 MW (414-500), 62%, of Chronos-2's gap to NESO, whose error is about 700 MW against Chronos-2's 980 MW.

title: Weather study results note, part 1 of 2 (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: Inputs differ: the regression has day-of-week, bank-holiday and Christmas terms and refits daily on a year; models see eight weeks and no calendar (called a design oversight). Exploratory, after publication: on 925 ordinary days Chronos-2 is 0.940 (0.907-0.971) of the regression; given the calendar too, 0.903 (0.871-0.933); Timestral 1.087 (1.046-1.131).

title: Weather study results note, part 1 of 2 (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: Setup: day D forecast issued 09:30 UK on D-1, half-hourly, MAE against INDO outturn. Weather: temperature, wind, solar; ECMWF 00 UTC run of D-1 (D-2 on 186 days), ERA5 history. Pinned revisions: amazon/chronos-2 29ec376, Timestral-209M 9874d25, timesfm-2.5 1d95242. Release dates given: Chronos-2 30 Oct 2025, TimesFM 2.5 15 Sep 2025, Timestral 15 Oct 2026.

title: Weather study results note, part 1 of 2 (weather_study/RESULTS.md)
note: Caveats the note states: the backtest overlaps the models' possible training period; a live window (20 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2027) reports in April 2027. Exploratory E1: on 367 days after its release Chronos-2's weather gain is 0.664 against 0.695 before. One departure from the plan: results reported now rather than after the live window. Nothing changed after the tag.

title: Weather study analysis plan (weather_study/PLAN.md)
note: Plan agreed 8 Nov 2026, amended 9 Nov, frozen at tag weather-plan before any forecaster was given real weather. Confirmatory: four backtest Q1 tests (weather helps each forecaster) at 0.0125 each. Q2 and Q3 (edge over the regression) are estimates with intervals, no test. Live-window tests are descriptive for lack of power. Gate checks and result sentences fixed in advance.

title: Weather study analysis plan (weather_study/PLAN.md)
note: Model interfaces: Chronos-2 (chronos-forecasting 2.3.2) takes t2m, wind, solar as past and future covariates, median as point forecast, no cross-learning; Timestral via known covariates; TimesFM 2.5 via its regression-on-covariates mode. Regression: weekly-lag terms plus temperature, its square, wind, temperature x wind, solar per half-hour slot, refit daily on 365 days.

title: winderai/demand-forecasting-benchmark
note: From the research call's sources (not fetched). A separate benchmark that includes GB national demand day ahead on 28 days of 2025 and a 5-day window in Oct 2026, with Timestral, Chronos-2 with and without temperature, scored by MASE against a seasonal naive. Different windows, metric and baseline; predates the study; not a replication of it.
